 Hibs striker Nathan Lowe to be out for longer than expected
 By John Hislop 
 October 24, 2026 10:53 am 
 Facebook X Pinterest WhatsApp Linkedin 
 Written by   John Hislop 
 HIBS manager Marink Reedijk has revealed that Nathan Lowe’s injury is ‘more complicated’ and will keep him out longer than expected. 
 He did however provide positive updates on Jacob Devaney and Callum Wright. 
 Reedijk confirmed the duo won’t be available for selection this weekend, with Devaney picking up   an injury through his red card at Dundee United, while Wright is nursing a groin problem.  
 Hibs host the league leaders on Sunday, targeting a first home win at Easter Road of the 2026/27 campaign and a first since April. 
 He said: “In this case I have no injuries, so it’s the same squad as last week. 
 “The first signs from Callum [Wright] and Jacob [Devaney] look positive at the moment, more positive than we expected, so that’s a good sign, but they are not ready for this match. 
 “That (Nathan Lowe’s injury) we will have to see, as this is a more complicated injury, so this can also be that in the next few days he’s back, but it can also take a little longer.”
